title: A failed launcher test leaves its launcher-fixture-* directory in the user's %TEMP%\termal\tests, outside the repository
outcome: The launcher tests (scripts/test-launcher.test.mjs, helper testTempDirectory) keep their fixtures inside the repository's ignored .tmp, or remove them even when a test fails, so that no agent ever has to clean the user profile. This matches the earlier fix for Rust fixtures (w-36ed6aab3dc0).
acceptance: The launcher test helper creates fixtures under the repository's ignored .tmp (or another in-repo ignored directory), not under the system temp folder. A test shows that a deliberately failing launcher test leaves nothing in the system temp folder.
Existing launcher tests stay green, and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
